vfairness.preprocessing.bias_detection.s.judgement: Overturned on audit and then fixed. Root cause: Two comparisons had no minimum on how much data they compared, so arithmetic produced three CRITICAL findings nobody measured. Over-reporting is the same defect class as under-reporting and needs the same three states.. Before: (1) an EMPTY frame with approved/pred/x, outcome='approved', prediction='pred' -> {'available': True, 'severity': 'critical', 'findings': [{'kind': 'circular_evaluation', ...}], 'checksRun': ['proxy_target', 'circular_evaluation']} with no warning, because Series([]).astype(str).equals(Series([]).astype(str)) is True over ZERO rows. (2) 50 rows with outcome and prediction both entirely NaN -> the same CRITICAL, because astype(str) maps every missing value to the string 'nan'. (3) pd.DataFrame({'approved': [1, 0], 'x': [5.0, 9.0], 'z': [2.0, 3.0]}), outcome='approved' -> severity 'critical', findings ['target_leakage', 'target_leakage'], both plain sentences '|r|=1.00', checksRun 'target_leakage (2 feature column(s) scanned)'.. Two unrecorded values would match as the string 'nan' ..." and "only 0 of 50 row(s)"; (3) -> "target_leakage: no feature column could be correlated against 'approved', so nothing was scanned (fewer than 10 row(s) sharing a value with 'approved': ['x (n=2)', 'z (n=2)'])".
